program_narrative: HISTLD00 is a batch program that loads transaction-history records from the indexed file TRANSACTION-HISTORY into the DB2 table POSHIST. It opens the history file for input and the batch-control file for update, connects to DB2 (through a paragraph that is not defined in this source), reads the HISTLD00 batch-control record and marks it active. The main loop reads history records sequentially until end of file or until more than 100 DB2 insert errors have occurred; each record read is copied field by field into the POSHIST-RECORD host structure and inserted into POSHIST, where a successful insert is counted, a duplicate key (SQLCODE -803) is silently skipped and any other SQL error is counted and passed to a DB2 error routine that is not defined in this source. Every WS-COMMIT-THRESHOLD (1000) loaded records the program commits and rewrites the batch-control checkpoint; at the end it commits, checkpoints, closes the files, disconnects from DB2 (undefined paragraph), displays read/written/error counts and returns the error count as RETURN-CODE. File-open errors, a missing control record and checkpoint rewrite failures go to 9000-ERROR-ROUTINE, which calls ERRPROC and rolls back but lets processing continue. The source fields moved into POSHIST (TH-*) and two checkpoint counters (BCT-RECORDS-READ/WRITTEN) are not declared in the program or its copybooks.

SQL COMMIT WORK  -- make all inserts since the last commit permanent

-- Commit every WS-COMMIT-THRESHOLD records and checkpoint progress
INCREMENT ws_commit_count BY 1
IF ws_commit_count >= ws_commit_threshold (1000) THEN
  SQL COMMIT WORK  -- make all inserts since the last commit permanent
  CLEAR ws_commit_count  -- set to zero
  CALL 2310-update-checkpoint
END IF
